status: DEMO RULES - NOT CLINICALLY VALIDATED. Configure with your clinical governance before any real use.
policy: A rule can only raise a flag for clinician review. No agent can lower or clear a flag; only a clinician acknowledgement can.

rules.label: Chest pain with red-flag features
rules.message: Chest pain with radiation, sweating, breathlessness, nausea, or not relieved by nitroglycerin. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Chest pain
rules.message: Chest pain reported. Clinician review required.

rules.label: Syncope or near-syncope
rules.message: Fainting or loss of consciousness reported. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Palpitations with dizziness
rules.message: Palpitations together with dizziness, light-headedness or chest pain. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Possible heart-failure decompensation
rules.message: Breathlessness lying flat or waking breathless, with swelling or weight gain. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Rapid weight gain or new swelling
rules.message: Weight gain or new ankle/leg swelling reported. Review fluid status.

rules.label: Bleeding while on an anticoagulant
rules.message: Bleeding symptoms reported by a patient taking an anticoagulant. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Anticoagulant with a bleeding-risk medicine
rules.message: Patient on an anticoagulant reports an NSAID or antiplatelet. Review the medication-safety alerts.

rules.label: Possible digoxin toxicity symptoms
rules.message: Visual changes or nausea reported by a patient taking digoxin. Review digoxin level and interactions.

rules.label: Nitrate with a PDE-5 inhibitor
rules.message: Nitrate use together with sildenafil/tadalafil reported (risk of severe hypotension). Clinician review now.

rules.label: Possible stroke signs
rules.message: Facial droop, slurred speech or one-sided weakness/numbness reported. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Possible anaphylaxis
rules.message: Throat or tongue swelling or breathing difficulty reported. Clinician review now.

rules.label: Sudden severe headache
rules.message: A sudden or 'worst ever' headache was reported (consider bleeding on anticoagulants). Clinician review now.

rules.label: Self-harm risk
rules.message: Statements about self-harm or suicide were detected. Clinician review now.
